feeds.title: EBC Brakes
feeds.description: With a worldwide workforce of over 400 people, EBC Brakes is an independently owned and managed leader in the brake market, proud of its customers, its products, its success, and its people. EBC Brakes produce the largest range of brake pads and brake discs in the world, with over 5000 part numbers for every type of moving vehicle.

feeds.title: TBM Brakes Blog
feeds.description: TBM Brakes is a manufacturer of high-quality brakes for racing applications. TBM Brakes leads the way in innovative direct-fit brake kits that outperform the competition every single time! Best drag racing brakes.

feeds.title: Brake & Front End
feeds.description: Brake & Front End serves repair shops conducting under-car repairs by providing application-specific technical ­information and solutions to address emerging trends in the ­undercar repair segment.

feeds.title: Brakes To Go Blog
feeds.description: Our Brakes To Go blog is filled with informative brake and car care tips written by brake experts. Brakes To Go provides mobile brake service that resolves the vast majority of brake maintenance issues while facilitating the most convenient and value-oriented customer service experience in the automotive service industry. Our mission is to provide honest & convenient brake repair with superior customer service to become the brake repair leader in Texas.

feeds.title: BuyBrakes
feeds.description: We wanted to make it easy for our customers to improve the brakes on their cars and trucks while saving time and money. Over twenty years later BuyBrakes.com has grown into the industry leader with proven, top-performing brake parts and brake upgrades for drivers and shops across the country.

feeds.title: Advanced Braking Technology Blog
feeds.description: Advanced Braking Technology (ABT) is a world-leading supplier of innovative, advanced brake systems. From its base in Perth, Western Australia, ABT supplies brakes to all seven continents for applications including mining, civil construction, military, freight, agriculture, and recreational/enthusiast off-road vehicles.

feeds.title: BrakesToYou Blog
feeds.description: We get it, car repair can be confusing and nerve-racking. That's why we've put together this blog to ease your mind and answer any questions you may have about your brakes. Since March 2020, we've been on a mission to make brake repair safer, way more convenient, and affordable.

feeds.title: Brake Boosters Blog
feeds.description: Learn tips on the trade from Brake Boosters, the people who've rebuilt and restored brake boosters for countless national award-winning cars. Specializing in Delco Moraine power brake boosters for most 1964 - 1984 GM muscle cars and trucks.

feeds.title: 2'u'Brakes Blog
feeds.description: We are Cincinnati's 1st mobile mechanic and this is our mobile mechanic blog! Learn how to maintain your vehicle to keep it safe and functioning properly at all times from a local ASE Certified mechanic. We offer this service to keep our customers informed about brake-related issues.

feeds.title: Rainbow Muffler & Brake Blog » Brake Repair
feeds.description: A family-owned company, Rainbow Muffler & Brake has more than a generation of experience serving the Cleveland, Ohio, area. From routine car maintenance to auto repair, we have you covered. We take pride in our work and support our nation by using high-quality, American-made parts. The blog features tips on maintaining your car and saving money on auto repairs, the Rainbow Muffler & Brake Blog is your go-to source for automotive knowledge.

feeds.title: Hollenshade's Blog » Brake Repair
feeds.description: Explore our blog for tips and maintenance advice for brakes. Hollenshade's Auto Service is dedicated to meeting your expectations every time you allow us to service your vehicle. We are a family-owned and operated business in Towson since 1939. We are always on-site to address any concerns you may have.

feeds.title: Dynamic Friction Blog
feeds.description: DFC's mission is to deliver quality, innovation, and value in the automotive industry by manufacturing OE-quality brake products for all foreign and domestic vehicles. We are the leading manufacturer of award-winning automotive braking systems. We maintain a massive inventory of brake parts for all domestic and foreign vehicle applications from 1930-present.

feeds.title: DON Brakes
feeds.description: DON has been at the forefront of brake friction technology for over 100 years. With a reputation for uncompromising quality and reliability, DON has retained its position as a strong market player in developing and supplying braking solutions. Stay up to date with the latest news from Don and the automotive industry.

feeds.title: Sangsin Brake Blog
feeds.description: For more than 50 years, Sangsin Brake has diligently researched and developed brake pads, linings, and other vehicle friction materials. With a focus on quality, Sangsin manufactures original equipment and service parts for some of the world's leading automotive manufacturers, premium global retailers, and its own brands.

feeds.title: The BRAKE Report
feeds.description: The BRAKE Report is the voice of the brake industry. Founded in 2012 by Brian Hagman, it connects brake professionals around the world through the latest news, interviews, company profiles, and more. It is the go-to resource for brake industry executives and professionals around the world.

feeds.title: NRS Brakes Blog
feeds.description: NRS is a patented process for surface modification of disc brake backing plates, adding a consistent matrix of raised steel hooks that facilitate the mechanical bond between disc brake plate and friction materials. We use galvanized steel construction and premium friction materials that never delaminate from the backing plate, giving you more secure, safer stops throughout the life of the entire brake pad.
